questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A group of people who live together in the same area is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A community is people living together in one area and sharing things like schools and markets.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which one of these gives health services in a community?
questions.explanation: A health centre is where people go when they are sick.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Who keeps law and order in a community?
questions.explanation: Police officers protect people and keep peace in the community.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Match each worker with the place where they work.
questions.explanation: Every community worker has a place where they do their work.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A family with a father, a mother and their children only is called a ______ family.
questions.explanation: A nuclear family is small: parents and their own children.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which person belongs to an extended family but NOT to a nuclear family?
questions.explanation: An extended family adds relatives like uncles, aunts and grandparents.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which one is a basic need of every family?
questions.explanation: Food, clothing and shelter are basic needs. Others are wants.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Who is the head of a primary school?
questions.explanation: The head teacher leads the school and all its teachers.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A school timetable helps learners know what to do at each time of the day.
questions.explanation: A timetable organises the school day so everyone knows what comes next.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Why does a school have rules?
options: B. To keep order and safety
questions.explanation: Rules keep everyone safe and help the school run well.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Who leads a village in Uganda?
questions.explanation: The LC I chairperson is the leader closest to the people in a village.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Amina finds a pen that belongs to her classmate. What is the right thing to do?
options: B. Give it back to the owner
questions.explanation: Returning what is not yours shows honesty, which is good citizenship.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: The capital city of Uganda is ______.
questions.explanation: Kampala is Uganda's capital city and its biggest town.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: How many main regions does Uganda have?
questions.explanation: Uganda has four regions: Central, Eastern, Northern and Western.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: In which region of Uganda is Kampala found?
questions.explanation: Kampala is in the Central region of Uganda.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which instrument measures the amount of rainfall?
questions.explanation: A rain gauge collects rain so we can measure how much fell.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A wind vane shows the direction from which the wind is blowing.
questions.explanation: A wind vane turns to point to where the wind comes from.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A farmer wants to dry maize. Which weather is best?
questions.explanation: Sunshine dries crops quickly and keeps them from rotting.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: How many cardinal points are there?
questions.explanation: The four cardinal points are North, East, South and West.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: The sun rises in the ______.
questions.explanation: The sun always rises in the east and sets in the west.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: If you face East, which direction is behind you?
questions.explanation: West is directly opposite East, so it is behind you.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: On a map, what usually shows water such as a lake?
questions.explanation: Map makers use blue for water bodies like lakes and rivers.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which means of transport moves on a road?
questions.explanation: Buses use roads. Trains use railways, ships use water, planes use air.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A letter is sent to another town through the ______ office.
questions.explanation: The post office collects and delivers letters and parcels.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which one is a modern means of communication?
questions.explanation: A mobile phone is modern. Drums and smoke were used long ago.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A person who treats sick people is called a ______.
questions.explanation: Doctors examine and treat sick people at health centres and hospitals.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A place where people buy and sell goods is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A market brings buyers and sellers together in one place.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which one is a tool used by a farmer?
questions.explanation: A hoe is used for digging and weeding in the garden.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: The national motto of Uganda is 'For God and My ______'.
questions.explanation: Uganda's motto is 'For God and My Country'.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which colour is at the top of the Uganda national flag?
questions.explanation: The Uganda flag starts with black at the top, then yellow, then red.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: The bird found on Uganda's Coat of Arms is the crested ______.
questions.explanation: The crested crane is Uganda's national bird.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which one is a way of passing on culture to children?
questions.explanation: Elders pass on culture through stories, songs, proverbs and dances.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Washing hands before eating helps to prevent ______.
questions.explanation: Clean hands stop germs from entering the body with food.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which one keeps the school compound clean?
questions.explanation: Sweeping and collecting rubbish stops flies and diseases.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Before crossing a road, you should look ______.
questions.explanation: Look both ways so you can see vehicles coming from either direction.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: You see a fire starting in the kitchen at home. What should you do first?
options: B. Tell an adult at once
questions.explanation: Telling an adult immediately brings help before the fire spreads.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Water, soil, trees and air are all called ______ resources.
questions.explanation: Natural resources are useful things we get from nature, not from factories.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Cutting down all the trees in an area is good for the environment.
questions.explanation: Cutting all trees causes soil erosion and less rain. We should plant more trees.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: The school is to the North of the church. In which direction is the church from the school?
questions.explanation: If A is north of B, then B must be south of A. Directions work both ways.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: How is a market different from a shop?
options: A. A market has many sellers in one open place, a shop usually has one seller
C. A shop has many sellers
D. They are exactly the same
questions.explanation: A market brings many traders together; a shop is usually run by one trader.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Why is it important for a village to have a health centre nearby?
options: A. So people travel far when sick
B. So sick people get treatment quickly
C. So the village looks big
questions.explanation: A nearby health centre means help arrives before an illness gets worse.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Your class wants to keep the classroom clean all week. Which plan works best?
options: A. Everybody cleans on Friday only
B. Make a duty rota so a group cleans each day
C. Wait for the teacher to clean
D. Clean only when visitors come
questions.explanation: A duty rota shares the work fairly and keeps the room clean every day.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Why should children know the leaders of their village?
options: B. To know who to report a problem to
questions.explanation: Knowing your leaders means you know where to go for help.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Your mother's sister is your ______.
questions.explanation: Your mother's sister is called your aunt.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Your father's father is your ______.
questions.explanation: The father of your father or mother is your grandfather.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Sweeping the compound at home is one of the ______ of a child.
questions.explanation: Children help at home by doing simple duties.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which one is a want rather than a need?
questions.explanation: Needs keep us alive. A television is nice to have but not needed.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Parents have a duty to send their children to school.
questions.explanation: Parents must provide care, food and education for their children.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which item at home should a young child NOT play with?
questions.explanation: Sharp tools like a panga can cause serious injury.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which material is used to build a permanent house?
questions.explanation: Bricks make strong, permanent walls.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Who helps the head teacher to lead learners in a school?
questions.explanation: Prefects are learners chosen to help lead other learners.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A learner breaks a school window while playing. What should she do?
options: B. Report it to a teacher
questions.explanation: Telling the truth is honest and helps the school repair the window.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: The book in which a learner writes class work is called an ______ book.
questions.explanation: Learners write their work in exercise books.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Coming to school on time is a good school habit.
questions.explanation: Being on time means you do not miss lessons.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Why is a school library useful to learners?
options: B. For reading and finding information
questions.explanation: A library keeps books that help learners read and learn more.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which one is a source of clean water in a community?
questions.explanation: Boreholes give safe water for drinking.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Where are letters and parcels handled?
questions.explanation: The post office handles letters and parcels.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Neighbours join together to repair a village path. This is called ______.
questions.explanation: Communal work is people working together for the good of all.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A person chosen by people to lead them is called a ______.
questions.explanation: Leaders are chosen to guide and speak for the people.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A village has one well that often breaks down. What is the best thing for the community to do?
options: A. Wait for it to break completely
B. Choose a group to look after and repair it
questions.explanation: Caring for shared property keeps it working for everyone.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Who is in charge of one class?
questions.explanation: Each class has a class teacher who looks after it.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which behaviour shows that a village leader can be trusted?
options: A. Telling the truth to the people
questions.explanation: A leader who tells the truth and is open with people earns their trust.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Rules help people to live together peacefully.
questions.explanation: Rules guide behaviour so people live together well.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which action shows good citizenship in a community?
options: A. Throwing rubbish in the road
questions.explanation: Helping others is a mark of a good citizen.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: You see a friend writing on a school wall. What is the best thing to do?
options: B. Politely tell him to stop and clean it
questions.explanation: Protecting school property helps everyone and stops damage.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: The area smaller than a region but bigger than a village is called a ______.
questions.explanation: Uganda is divided into districts for easier administration.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which region of Uganda lies in the far north?
questions.explanation: The Northern region lies in the north of Uganda.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which one is the money used in Uganda?
questions.explanation: Uganda uses the Uganda Shilling.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: The country found to the south of Uganda is ______.
questions.explanation: Tanzania borders Uganda on the south.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A raised piece of land smaller than a mountain is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A hill is raised land, but lower than a mountain.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A large body of water surrounded by land is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A lake is water surrounded by land.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Water that flows in a channel from a highland to a lake is called a ______.
questions.explanation: Rivers flow from high ground down to lakes or seas.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which weather has a lot of clouds but no rain?
questions.explanation: Cloudy weather means the sky is covered by clouds.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Where in a school are weather instruments kept?
questions.explanation: A weather station is an open place where instruments are kept.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: People wear heavy clothes when the weather is cold.
questions.explanation: Warm clothing protects the body from cold.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Why do farmers plant seeds at the start of the rainy season?
options: A. So seeds get enough water to grow
B. Because the soil is dry
questions.explanation: Young plants need steady rain to grow well.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which action pollutes a river?
questions.explanation: Rubbish makes river water dirty and unsafe.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Planting trees to replace those cut down helps to protect the ______.
questions.explanation: Trees hold the soil, give shade and help bring rain.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which natural resource is used for making bricks?
questions.explanation: Bricks are moulded from clay soil.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which natural resource gives us fish?
questions.explanation: Fish are caught from lakes, rivers and swamps.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which means of transport is used on a lake?
questions.explanation: Boats and canoes move people and goods on water.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Where should a pedestrian walk along a busy road?
options: B. On the walkway at the side
questions.explanation: Walkways keep people away from moving vehicles.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Long ago, people passed messages in a village by beating a ______.
questions.explanation: Drums were beaten to call people or warn of danger.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which one reaches many people at the same time?
questions.explanation: Radio sends the same message to very many listeners at once.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which one is a food crop?
questions.explanation: Maize is grown mainly to be eaten.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which animal gives us milk?
questions.explanation: Cows are kept for milk and meat.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: The keeping of birds such as hens for eggs and meat is called ______.
questions.explanation: Poultry keeping is rearing birds like hens and ducks.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A person who sells goods in small quantities to people is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A retailer sells small amounts directly to buyers.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which goods are usually sold in a food market?
questions.explanation: Food markets sell farm produce like vegetables and grains.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Mary has 2,000 shillings. She buys a book at 1,200 shillings. How much is left?
questions.explanation: 2,000 minus 1,200 leaves 800 shillings.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Sleeping under a treated mosquito net prevents ______.
questions.explanation: Mosquito nets stop mosquito bites that spread malaria.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which meal is the most balanced?
questions.explanation: A balanced meal mixes different food groups.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Human waste should be disposed of in a ______.
questions.explanation: Using a latrine keeps germs away from people and water.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Children should swim in a lake without an adult watching them.
questions.explanation: Swimming without an adult is dangerous. Always be supervised.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which one can start a fire at home?
options: B. A lit candle left alone
questions.explanation: An unattended flame can set nearby things alight.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which one is a traditional Ugandan food?
questions.explanation: Matooke is a common traditional food in Uganda.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: The language spoken by a group of people as their mother tongue is called their ______ language.
questions.explanation: A local language is the one a community grew up speaking.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: What should you do when the National Anthem is being sung?
questions.explanation: Standing still and quiet shows respect for the country.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Why does a country have national symbols such as a flag?
options: B. To show the country's identity and unity
questions.explanation: Symbols stand for the country and bring people together.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: A drawing of a place as seen from above is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A map shows a place from above, drawn on paper.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: On a map, a small drawing that stands for a real thing is called a ______.
questions.explanation: Symbols stand for real features like schools or roads.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Which direction is opposite North?
questions.explanation: South is directly opposite North.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: The market is East of the school. In which direction is the school from the market?
questions.explanation: If the market is east of the school, the school is west of the market.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Match each worker with what they produce or provide.
questions.explanation: Different workers provide different goods and services.

questions.subject: SST
questions.question: Why do people in a community do different kinds of work?
options: B. So that all the different needs of the community are met
questions.explanation: When people specialise, the community gets all the goods and services it needs.
